theme_strategy: Hybrid Architecture (Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast). Dark, immersive 'Motion as Product' marketing page to build technical credibility, transitioning to a dense, stark-white, high-efficiency dashboard for AE and SDR daily operations.

headings.rules: Must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter) for H1/H2. Never center-align by default. Do NOT use Inter.

scales.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-bold
scales.h2: text-2xl md:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-semibold

body.rules: Left-aligned for all dense content, tables, and AI insights. Use leading-relaxed for long-form text (AI generated emails).

colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast with Electric Blue AI Accents
colors.rules: Tint all grays slightly with cool blue. Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Ensure APCA contrast compliance, especially for lead scores and AI insights. Use primary color strictly for CTAs, AI action triggers, and primary metrics.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky header and AI generation loading overlays. bg-white/70 or bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl, saturate-150, and 1px delicate inner border.
visual_enhancers.neumorphism: Avoided. Stick to sharp, high-contrast Swiss geometry.
visual_enhancers.borders_and_shadows: Dashboard uses 1px solid borders (border-border) with NO shadows by default. Hover states introduce shadow-lg and -translate-y-1 for interactive cards.
visual_enhancers.the_tracing_beam: Apply to the 'AI Qualification Summary' component to visually distinguish AI-generated intelligence from standard CRM data.

component_rules.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, and Form. Never native inputs. Wrap with generous padding (p-6).
component_rules.tables: Dense layout. Use Shadcn Table. Lead scores must use badge components with dynamic color coding (Green > 80, Yellow 50-79, Red < 50).
component_rules.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md) with micro-interactions. Hover must explicitly change text color and background.
component_rules.cards: For marketing: use custom HTML/Tailwind for bento boxes (no rigid Shadcn cards). For dashboard: use Shadcn Cards with modified padding (p-6) and zero default shadows.
component_rules.drawers: Use Shadcn Sheet for the Lead Detail view, sliding in from the right. Must contain the AI generated email and activity timeline.

grids.marketing: Mode A (Tetris Grid). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Heavy asymmetry. Hero section spans full width, supporting bento boxes span 4 or 8 columns.
grids.dashboard: Mode B (High Density). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6. KPI summary widgets are col-span-1. Main analytics chart is col-span-2 or col-span-3. Lead list spans full width below.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, py-24 for marketing sections. Inside dashboard cards, use p-6 (never less than p-4).
layouts.alignment: Mobile-first. Left-align text by default. Only center-align hero text if balanced with symmetrical graphics.
layouts.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header. Z-index 50. Must have Brand, 4 links, and Primary CTA on desktop.

motion.micro_interactions: All buttons and table rows must have hover:bg and hover:translate-y-[1px] or similar transitions.
motion.page_transitions: Use Framer Motion for staggered entrance of dashboard cards (duration 0.4s, stagger 0.1s).
motion.ai_loading: Use a staggered skeleton loader or ASCII art loader to simulate AI 'thinking' during qualification or email generation.
motion.rules: Do NOT use `transition: all`. Use specific `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for standard text. Test all AI generated text overlays.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (tabs, table rows, form inputs, generate button) MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='login-form-submit-button'`).
accessibility.screen_readers: Use aria-hidden='true' for purely decorative AI graphics or icons.

media.image_constraints: Hero images must not exceed max-h-[80vh] on mobile. Images inside bento grids must have object-cover.
media.overlays: Marketing hero image must have bg-black/40 overlay to ensure text readability.

3d_libraries.charts: Recharts for the Analytics Dashboard (Lead Conversion Funnel, Score Distribution).
3d_libraries.animations: framer-motion for marketing bento grid reveals and 'Live AI Agent' simulated cursor movements.
3d_libraries.icons: lucide-react for standard UI. Install @phosphor-icons/react for high-end duotone dashboard icons.

marketing_hero_bg.description: Abstract blue geometric pattern. Place behind the hero section with a dark overlay (bg-black/60) to frame the value proposition.

about_team.description: Diverse team collaborating. Use in the 'Why Us' or 'Human in the Loop' section of the marketing page.

social_proof_logos.description: Logitech logo for social proof/trusted by section.
Pexels logo for social proof/trusted by section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute Phase 1: Set up the Tailwind configuration using the colors and fonts defined in this JSON. Ensure font families Manrope and IBM Plex Sans are imported.
Execute Phase 2: Build the Marketing Landing Page using a dark theme, Bento Grid layout (Mode A), and Framer Motion for staggered reveals. Build using .jsx/.js files.
Execute Phase 3: Build the Dashboard Layout using a light theme (Swiss High-Contrast). Create KPI widgets, the Leads Table with status badges, and the Analytics view using Recharts.
Execute Phase 4: Build the Lead Detail Drawer (using Shadcn Sheet). Include the AI Qualification Summary and 'AI Personalized Email Generator' layout.
Execute Phase 5: Integrate Settings page for Slack, HubSpot, and n8n webhook toggles.
CRITICAL: Do NOT center-align the app container. Left-align text blocks by default.
CRITICAL: Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, form inputs, and major layout sections.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions.
CRITICAL: Create components and views as .js or .jsx files, not .tsx files.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like robot, brain, lightbulb, target, etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js or standard ui location.
